svg.title: R-waste-P - Waste & Recycling Plant - plan
svg.text: CLEAR: 2.8 m forklift lane from the corridor door to the bale pallets and the digester
The Waste & Recycling Plant takes everything the crew throw away - paper, plastics, metal, food scraps, medical
and chemical waste - sorts it, shreds and bales what can be re-made in the Fabrication Hall, digests the wet
waste into compost and gas, and burns only the residue.
Operator station (west wall, north of the door)
Intake hopper, chutes and sorting conveyors (north wall)
Shredder / blower and off-gas scrubbing (east wall, north)
Digester and sump (east wall, south of the lane)
Sorting bins and hazardous waste (south wall, west)
Decontamination and PPE (west wall, south of the door)
Floor props as oriented footprints (front edge heavy); wall items = bars on wall; ceiling items dotted
